title: promote_to_template specification
description: specification payload for action=promote_to_template (ADR-0008). Destructive by default dry_run at envelope options level.

source_asset.description: Asset path of a successful effect/graph to promote.

base_template_id.description: Optional parent template this promotion varies from.

proposed_template_id.description: Desired new template_id. If omitted, derived deterministically from source + base. Contract validation does not imply the source was inspected or a template was written.

quarantine.description: When true, resolve output under /Game/__UeremcpTemplates/agent/ only. The current scaffold remains preview-only until complete-state retrieval, plan synthesis, schema validation, and the shared security write gate are bound.
